initial.method: Actual C9 scene and pinned nine assets. Main RAF frozen/time14; per view select once, AO .55 then0 only. Each state retains one warmup plus two fresh render captures. Current default service preset plus exact saved C8 legacy service world camera for identical HDR ROI comparison. 20/21 formulas and FOV58 match C8 AO experiment. No contrast ABA, UI/physics test, performance claim, source/material/quality/light replacement.

exitScope: Derived from driver/report ok; not a persisted OS process exit observation.
